_about: Mood (List 21, #202): the third temperament layer — a decaying, read-time PROJECTION, not a record. Layer 1: the seed (stored birth fact, #80). Layer 2: temperament (derived once from the seed, fixed for the individual's life, #108). Layer 3 (this): mood, derived at read time from RECENT facts, decaying toward the temperament baseline. Mood creates no stored facts and writes nothing, anywhere.
battle_fence: Mood is NOT a battle input. Battle expression of the relationship is #180's bond lane, reading bond facts. A proposal wanting mood in battle arrives as a revision to #202's file, argued on its face — never as a silent consumer.
consumers_exactly: #152 behaviour-profile views (mood weights WHICH stocked behaviour plays)
#160 field-partner assistance (mood colours the eagerness/read of the sign:/find:/danger: REACT selection — the selection, never the effects; #160's boundary stands verbatim)
inputs: recent care events from the Garden care loop, timestamped (#28 family), recency-windowed
effective weather — #61's output read THROUGH #142's climate, as all weather consumers must (sustained storm weighs; a single shower is weather, not a mood)
the individual's own recent battle/event outcomes (#12-class timestamped facts of participation)

layers.form: derived once from the seed (5x5 cell + characteristic line)
derived at read time from recent facts
layers.lifetime: hours — decays to the temperament baseline

open_register: window / decay / weight constants entire (design values)
whether weather weight reads #142's climate IDENTITY or only the current state (flagged design question)
the mood vocabulary the behaviour views render in (design lane's words)
any consumer beyond #152/#160 (a revision to #202's file — or none)
projection: pure function of (inputs, clock): same facts + same moment = same mood, for every consumer. As inputs age out of the window, the read decays toward the #108 temperament baseline — a mood is a deviation with a half-life, not a new personality. Window, decay curve, and per-class weights are DATA SLOTS (OPEN) — no constants asserted.
show_lane_mirror: Mood is a performance note handed to direction via #152's show view ('flat today, storm-worn'). The show never names mood as a system and shows no meter; a creature's day is played, not displayed.
writes: NOTHING. No flag, no care axis, no honours, no bond change, no field on #80's record — proposed or otherwise.
